# Changelog

All notable changes to `pi-json-tools` will be documented in this file.

---

## [5.2.2] - 2026-05-03
### Fixed
- Truncation false positive: parse tool calls dulu sebelum cek truncation
- Hallucinated path gate sekarang trigger sebelum delegate ke Pi native tool (read/write/edit/dll)

---

## [5.2.1] - 2026-05-03
### Fixed
- Hallucinated path gate dipindah ke sebelum semua tool delegate, bukan hanya bash

---

## [5.2.0] - 2026-05-03
### Added
- Multi-language detection: Japanese, Korean, Arabic
- Auto-detect no-tool model via error message
- Truncation detection & retry handler
- Hallucinated path gate (bash only)
- `stripJsonFromText` — bersihkan sisa JSON dari chat response
- `noToolModelCache` untuk performa
- Config `models` list diperluas (llama, mistral, phi, gemma, dll)

---

## [5.1.1] - 2026-05-02
### Added
- Proper Pi Extension API integration
- `before_agent_start` system prompt injection
- `context` event untuk inject real env
- Auto reminder format JSON

---

## [5.0.6] - 2026-05-01
### Fixed
- Minor bug fixes

---

## [5.0.0] - 2026-04-30
### Added
- Execwith timeout bash execution
- Env context injection
- `before_agent_start` event handler

---

## [4.x] - 2026-04
### Added
- Robust multi-format JSON parser
- Auto-detect tool call format (6 format didukung)
- Pi native tool delegate (read/write/edit/grep/find)
- Auto retry parsing hingga maxRetries

---

## [1.0.0 - 3.x] - Early releases
- Initial release & iterasi awal smart recovery untuk Qwen Coder
